extensionDescription.message: Paint parts of images on web pages, then grab, stretch, and watch them wobble.

closeTitle.message: Restore the image and close the extension controls

releaseTitle.message: Remove the effect and painted mask from the selected image

dragHint.message: Drag a painted area and release

sourceChanged.message: The image changed. Select it again with “Select image”.

pickHint.message: Click an image on the page

grabHelp.message: Pull a painted area and release

eraseHelp.message: Erase areas that should stay still

brushHelp.message: Paint where it should move, then choose Grab

selectingTitle.message: Click an image on the page. Press I or Esc to cancel.

selectTitle.message: Select an image on the page (I)

imageRemoved.message: The image was removed from the page. Select another image.

captured.message: Captured the visible image. Paint where it should move.

loaded.message: Paint where it should move, then pull it with Grab.

paintFirst.message: Paint an area first to make it move.

sizeChanged.message: The image size changed. Select it again.

areaChanged.message: The visible image area changed. Select it again.

bringIntoView.message: Bring the image into view before selecting it.

captureFailed.message: Could not capture the image. Keep the tab visible and try again.

captureChanged.message: The image or viewport changed during capture. Select the image again.

unsupportedPage.message: Unavailable on this page. Open a regular web page.

keepTabVisible.message: Keep the target tab visible while selecting an image.

webglFailed.message: Could not initialize WebGL2. Use a supported browser with GPU acceleration enabled.
